# Fig S1. Temperature depth profiles
```{r, echo=FALSE}
# The calculated trait values
load("data/uvp6_images_calculated_traits_20260321.RData")
# The CTD data
load("data/uvp6_associated_ctd_20260330.RData")

# Temporal frequency
df.meta <- Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
  arrange(-maxSampleDepth) %>% 
  distinct(station_year, .keep_all = T) 

df.meta %>% 
  distinct(region.inuktitut, Year) %>% 
  arrange(region.inuktitut)

df.meta.months <- df.meta %>% 
  group_by(region.inuktitut, Month_Name) %>% 
  summarise(nprofiles = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Month_Name, values_from = nprofiles) %>% 
  relocate(region.inuktitut, July, August, September, October)

df.meta.depths <- df.meta %>% 
  mutate(region = region.inuktitut) %>% 
  group_by(region) %>% 
  summarise(nprofiles = n(), 
            mean_bottom = mean(bottom_depth_m),
            sd_bottom = sd(bottom_depth_m),
            .groups = "drop") 

## organize CTD metadata

# Subset the CTD data to the 208 profiles analyzed
ctd_meta_208 <- uvp6_ctd_match %>% 
  filter(sample_id %in% df.meta$sample_id)

ctd_208 <- ctd %>% 
  filter(filename %in% ctd_meta_208$ctd_filename) %>% 
  left_join(df.meta %>% 
              select(filename = ctd_filename, region = region.inuktitut),
            by = "filename") 

# Calculate mixed layer depth (MLD) based on sigma = 0.003 threshold
mld.df <- ctd_208 %>% 
  select(filename, cast_number, station, pressure, sigt) %>% 
  group_by(filename, cast_number, station) %>% 
  # Get MLD as 0.003 threshold
  arrange(pressure) %>% 
  mutate(
    sigt_ref = mean(sigt[pressure <= 5], na.rm = TRUE),
    delta_sigt = sigt - sigt_ref
  ) %>% 
  summarise(
    mld = if (any(delta_sigt >= 0.003, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      pressure[which(delta_sigt >= 0.003)[1]]
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )


temp_thresh <- 0.2 

mldT.df <- ctd_208 %>% 
  select(filename, cast_number, station, pressure, te90) %>% 
  group_by(filename, cast_number, station) %>% 
  arrange(pressure) %>% 
  mutate(
    temp_ref = mean(te90[pressure <= 5], na.rm = TRUE),
    delta_temp = abs(te90 - temp_ref)
  ) %>% 
  summarise(
    mld_temp = if (any(delta_temp >= temp_thresh, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      pressure[which(delta_temp >= temp_thresh)[1]]
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Average temperature above and below the mixed layer
df.ctd.mld <- ctd_208 %>% 
  left_join(mld.df %>% 
              select(filename, mld), by = "filename") %>% 
    mutate( layer = case_when(
      is.na(mld) ~ NA_character_,
      pressure <= mld ~ "above_mld",
      pressure >  mld ~ "below_mld") ) %>% 
  # assign below mld for NA values
  mutate(layer = if_else(is.na(layer), "below_mld", layer)) %>% 
  group_by(filename, region, layer) %>% 
  summarise(
    mean_te90 = mean(te90, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_psal = mean(psal, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_sigt = mean(sigt, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_mld = mean(mld, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  group_by(region, layer) %>% 
  summarise(
    n_ctd = n(),
    mld_mean = mean(mean_mld, na.rm = TRUE),
    mld_sd = sd(mean_mld, na.rm = TRUE),
    temp_mean = mean(mean_te90, na.rm = TRUE),
    temp_sd = sd(mean_te90, na.rm = TRUE),
    sali_mean = mean(mean_psal, na.rm = TRUE),
    sali_sd = sd(mean_psal, na.rm = TRUE),
    dens_mean = mean(mean_sigt, na.rm = TRUE),
    dens_sd = sd(mean_sigt, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  filter(layer == "below_mld")

# Calculate temperature below 200 m and 500 m and upper 50 m Fluorescence... FLOR (ug/L) and CDOM

ctd.meta.50m <- ctd_208 %>% 
  filter(pressure <= 50) %>% 
  select(filename, region,te90,psal,flor,cdom,sigt) %>% 
  group_by(filename, region) %>% 
  summarise(across(te90:sigt, ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  group_by(region) %>% 
  summarise(across(te90:sigt,
              list(mean_50m = mean, sd_50m = sd), na.rm = TRUE), 
            .groups = "drop")

ctd.meta.200m <- ctd_208 %>% 
  filter(pressure > 200) %>% 
  select(filename, region,te90,psal,flor,cdom,sigt) %>% 
  group_by(filename, region) %>% 
  summarise(across(te90:sigt, ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  group_by(region) %>% 
  summarise(across(te90:sigt,
              list(mean_200m = mean, sd_200m = sd), na.rm = TRUE), 
            .groups = "drop")

ctd.meta.500m <- ctd_208 %>% 
  filter(pressure > 500) %>% 
  select(filename, region,te90,psal,flor,cdom,sigt) %>% 
  group_by(filename, region) %>% 
  summarise(across(te90:sigt, ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  group_by(region) %>% 
  summarise(across(te90:sigt,
              list(mean_500m = mean, sd_500m = sd), na.rm = TRUE), 
            .groups = "drop")


# Combine everything to a table with columns:MLD, Temp below MLD, 200m and 500m
df.meta.clean <- df.ctd.mld %>% 
  select(region, n_ctd, mld_mean, mld_sd,
         temp_mean_mld = temp_mean, temp_sd_mld = temp_sd) %>% 
  left_join(ctd.meta.200m %>% 
              select(region, te90_mean_200m, te90_sd_200m)) %>% 
  left_join(ctd.meta.500m %>% 
              select(region, te90_mean_500m, te90_sd_500m)) %>% 
  
  mutate(
    mld = paste0(round(mld_mean, 1), " \u00B1 ", round(mld_sd, 1)),
    temp_mld = paste0(round(temp_mean_mld, 1), " \u00B1 ", round(temp_sd_mld, 1)),
    temp_200m = paste0(round(te90_mean_200m, 1), " \u00B1 ", round(te90_sd_200m, 1)),
    temp_500m = paste0(round(te90_mean_500m, 1), " \u00B1 ", round(te90_sd_500m, 1))) %>% 
  select(-c(mld_mean:te90_sd_500m))


clrs <- c("firebrick","#FF6800","#FFB300","forestgreen", "blue1","purple2","#F6768E")

region_temp_profiles_5m <- ctd_208 %>% 
  # limit the mean+sd bottom depth
  left_join(df.meta.depths, by = join_by(region)) %>% 
  filter(pressure <= (mean_bottom + sd_bottom)) %>% 
  mutate(depth_bin = floor(pressure/5)*5)  %>% 
  group_by(filename, cruise_name, station, datetime, latitude, longitude,
           region, depth_bin) %>% 
  summarise(temp.mean = mean(te90, na.rm = T),
            temp.sd = sd(te90, na.rm = T),
            ntra.mean = mean(ntra, na.rm = T),
            psal.mean = mean(psal, na.rm = T),
            flor.mean = mean(flor, na.rm = T),
            oxym.mean = mean(oxym, na.rm = T),
            ndepths = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(temp.mean)) %>% 
  group_by(region, depth_bin) %>% 
  summarise(reg.temp.mean = mean(temp.mean, na.rm = T),
            reg.temp.sd = sd(temp.mean, na.rm = T),
            reg.ntra.mean = mean(ntra.mean, na.rm = T),
            reg.psal.mean = mean(psal.mean, na.rm = T),
            reg.flor.mean = mean(flor.mean, na.rm = T),
            reg.oxym.mean = mean(oxym.mean, na.rm = T),
            reg.nprofiles = n(), .groups = "drop") 

# *** Plot individual profiles and overlay the mean temperature ***

# Separate 2 rows of regions
upperplot <- c("Nares Strait",
               "Pikialasorsuaq\n(North Water Polynya)",
               "Tallurutiup Imanga\n(Lancaster Sound)")

g1 <- ggplot() +
  
  # Mean bottom depth marker
  geom_rect(data = df.meta.depths %>%
               filter(region %in% upperplot),
             aes(xmin = mean_bottom - sd_bottom,
                 xmax = mean_bottom + sd_bottom,
                 ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
                 group = region),
             fill = "gray80", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(data = df.meta.depths %>% 
               filter(region %in% upperplot), 
             aes(xintercept = mean_bottom, group = region),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "gray30") +
  
  geom_line(data = ctd_208 %>% 
         filter(region %in% upperplot), 
       aes(x = pressure, y = te90, group = filename, color = region),
       alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(data = region_temp_profiles_5m %>% 
         filter(region %in% upperplot), 
       aes(x = depth_bin, y = reg.temp.mean, group = region), 
       color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_reverse(expand = c(0,0)) +
  coord_flip() +
  xlab("Depth (m)") +
  # ylab("Temperature (°C)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none", 
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank()) +
  scale_color_manual(values = clrs[1:3], 
                     name = "Region") +
  facet_wrap(~region, scales = "free", nrow = 1)

g2 <- ggplot() +
  
    geom_rect(data = df.meta.depths %>%
               filter(region %notin% upperplot),
             aes(xmin = mean_bottom - sd_bottom,
                 xmax = mean_bottom + sd_bottom,
                 ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
                 group = region),
             fill = "gray80", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(data = df.meta.depths %>% 
               filter(region %notin% upperplot), 
             aes(xintercept = mean_bottom, group = region),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "gray30") +
  
  geom_line(data = ctd_208 %>% 
         filter(region %notin% upperplot), 
       aes(x = pressure, y = te90, group = filename, color = region),
       alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(data = region_temp_profiles_5m %>% 
         filter(region %notin% upperplot), 
       aes(x = depth_bin, y = reg.temp.mean, group = region), 
       color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_reverse(expand = c(0,0)) +
  coord_flip() +
  xlab("Depth (m)") +
  ylab("Temperature (°C)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none", strip.background = element_blank()) +
  scale_color_manual(values = clrs[4:7], 
                     name = "Region") +
  facet_wrap(~region, scales = "free", nrow = 1)

cowplot::plot_grid(cowplot::plot_grid(NULL,g1,NULL, 
                                      nrow = 1, rel_widths = c(0.5,3,0.5)),
                   g2,ncol = 1)
```

## Calculate average temperature per profile
```{r, echo=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
ctd_208_200m <- ctd_208 %>% 
  left_join(uvp6_ctd_match %>% 
               select(Site, filename = ctd_filename), by = "filename") %>% 
  filter(depth > 200) %>% 
  # Rename station_year to match how these are coded for the UVP6 data
  mutate(year = year(datetime)) %>% 
  mutate(station_year = if_else(year == 2021,
                                paste(tolower(station), year),
                                paste(Site,year))) %>% 
  mutate(station_year = if_else(station_year == "de500/gliders 2021",
                                "de500 2021", station_year),
         station_year = if_else(station_year == "bb2 2021",
                                "de_bb2_float 2021", station_year)) %>% 
  
  group_by(region, station_year) %>% 
  summarise(temp_200m = mean(te90, na.rm = T),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(temp_200m))

# save(ctd_208_200m,
#      file = "data/ctd_profile_mean_temp_200m_20260511.RData")
```

# Fig S2. Distribution of community weighted mean trait values and experienced temperatures 
```{r, echo=FALSE}
clrs <- c("firebrick","#FF6800","#FFB300","forestgreen", "blue1","purple2","#F6768E")

# Calculate community weighted mean of mean traits (weighted by abundance)
cwm.profiles <- indiv_traits %>% 
  # only include Calanus spp
  filter(taxa == "Calanus") %>% 
  # add volume filtered
  mutate(Depth_5m = floor(object_depth_max / 5) * 5 + 2.5) %>% 
  left_join(volumes.df) %>% 
  # add regions
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              select(sample_id, region.inuk, reg.inuk, station_year)) %>% 
  # filter samples for analysis
  filter(!is.na(region.inuk)) %>% 
  # calculate portion of the volume to get relative abundance
  mutate(rel_abundance = Sampled_volume_m3) %>% 
  mutate(temperature_C = temperature_kelvin - 273.15) %>% 
  select(station_year, region.inuk, reg.inuk, rel_abundance,
         prosome_length_mm, lipid_fullness, waxester_mass_mgC, temperature_C,
         respirationRate_ugCday, diapauseDuration_day, 
         structural_carbon_mgC, prosome_total_mgC) %>% 
  group_by(station_year, region.inuk, reg.inuk) %>% 
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric),  
                   ~ weighted.mean(.x, rel_abundance, na.rm = TRUE)),
            nindivs = n(),
            .groups = "drop")

cwm.profiles.long <- cwm.profiles %>% 
  select(-c(prosome_total_mgC, structural_carbon_mgC)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(prosome_length_mm, lipid_fullness, waxester_mass_mgC,
                        respirationRate_ugCday, diapauseDuration_day,
                        temperature_C),
               names_to = "trait", values_to = "value") %>% 
  mutate(trait = factor(trait, 
                        levels = c("prosome_length_mm", "waxester_mass_mgC",
                                    "lipid_fullness", "respirationRate_ugCday",
                                   "diapauseDuration_day", "temperature_C")))
  

flabels <- c("prosome_length_mm" = "a. Prosome length\n(mm)", 
             "waxester_mass_mgC" = "b. Wax ester carbon\n(mg C)",
             "lipid_fullness" = "c. Lipid fullness\n(%)", 
             "respirationRate_ugCday" = "d. Diapause respiration rate\n(\u03bcg C day⁻¹)",
             "diapauseDuration_day" = "e. Potential diapause duration\n(day)", 
             "temperature_C" = "f. Ambient temperature\n(°C)")

ggplot(cwm.profiles.long, aes(x = reg.inuk, y = value,
                         color = reg.inuk)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev, labels = flabels) +
  scale_color_manual(values = clrs) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank()) +
  facet_wrap(~trait, scales = "free_x",
              labeller = as_labeller(flabels))
```

# Fig S3. Additional GAM plots
```{r}
# Integrated UVP results
load("data/profile_integrated_cflux_20260505.RData")

# The results of the GAM analysis of fluxes
load("data/global_GAM_results_20260629.RData")

clrs <- c("firebrick","#FF6800","#FFB300","forestgreen", "blue1","purple2","#F6768E")

p1 <- ggplot(df.profile.lpc, aes(x = latitude, y = total_gC_flux_m2)) +
  geom_ribbon(data = fit.lat,
              aes(x = latitude, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr),
```

# Fig S6. Particulate organic carbon (POC) flux calculated at various reference depths and compared to the lipid pump carbon (LPC) flux.

## Load literature data and the calculated POC fluxes
```{r}
# The annual sediment trap data organized from Hargave et al. (2002) and Lalande et al. (2009)
sedTrap <- read.csv("data/open_data_csv/Sediment_trap_literature_20260929.csv")

# Annual Arctic data
sedTrap.Arctic <- sedTrap %>%
  filter(!is.na(Annual_Flux)) %>% 
  mutate(AreaCode = case_match(AreaCode,
                               "NOW" ~ "Pikia",
                               "Amundsen" ~ "Amun",
                               "Laptev" ~ "Lapt",
                               "Mackenzie" ~ "Mack",
                               .default = "") ) %>% 
  mutate(AreaCode = factor(AreaCode,
                           levels = c("Pikia","Amun",
                                      "Lapt","Mack")))

clrs <- c("firebrick","#FF6800","#FFB300","forestgreen", "blue1","purple2","#F6768E")
```

## Plot the figure

## Compare lipid pump distributions between regions
```{r, echo=FALSE}
# KW and Dunns test for significant differences in medians
df <- df.profile %>% 
  mutate(region = region.inuk)

# *** Carbon flux ***
kruskal.test(total_gC_flux_m2 ~ region, data = df) 
res.dunn <- dunn.test::dunn.test(x = df$total_gC_flux_m2,
                     g = df$region,
                     kw = F,
                     method = "bh")
subset( data.frame(comp = res.dunn$comparisons, p = res.dunn$P.adjusted),
  p >= 0.025 )



# *** Abundance ***
kruskal.test(abundance_m2 ~ region, data = df) 
res.dunn <- dunn.test::dunn.test(x = df$abundance_m2,
                     g = df$region,
                     kw = F,
                     method = "bh")
subset( data.frame(comp = res.dunn$comparisons, p = res.dunn$P.adjusted),
  p >= 0.025 )

# *** Biomass ***
kruskal.test(biomass_gC_m2 ~ region, data = df) 
res.dunn <- dunn.test::dunn.test(x = df$biomass_gC_m2,
                     g = df$region,
                     kw = F,
                     method = "bh")
subset( data.frame(comp = res.dunn$comparisons, p = res.dunn$P.adjusted),
  p >= 0.025 )

# % WE in biom
kruskal.test(we_perc_biom ~ region, data = df) # not sig diff

# % Cflux to total carbon biomass (amount of biomass contributed to C flux)
kruskal.test(fraction_C_flux ~ region, data = df) 
res.dunn <- dunn.test::dunn.test(x = df$fraction_C_flux,
                     g = df$region,
                     kw = F,
                     method = "bh")
subset( data.frame(comp = res.dunn$comparisons, p = res.dunn$P.adjusted),
  p < 0.025 )


# % respired to total C flux
kruskal.test(frac_resp_total ~ region, data = df) 
res.dunn <- dunn.test::dunn.test(x = df$fraction_C_flux,
                     g = df$region,
                     kw = F,
                     method = "bh")
subset( data.frame(comp = res.dunn$comparisons, p = res.dunn$P.adjusted),
  p < 0.025 )
```

# Table S8. Within-subregion paired comparisons between the LPC and POC200m fluxes. 
- Run paired t-test first, if normality violated, used wilcoxon signed rank test

## Paired t-test + wilxox signed
```{r}
load("data/UVP6_POC_lipidC_flux_comparisons_20260515.RData")
# paired t-test + normality check of paired differences
results.200 <- flux.com.profiles.200 %>%
  mutate(
    POC_Flux = poc_gC_m2_yr,
    LipidC_Flux = lipid_gC_m2_yr,
    diff_flux = LipidC_Flux - POC_Flux,
    LPC_POC = lipid_gC_m2_yr/poc_gC_m2_yr
  ) %>% 
  group_by(reg.inuk) %>%
  summarise(n_pairs = sum(!is.na(POC_Flux) & !is.na(LipidC_Flux)),
            mean_LPC_Flux = mean(LipidC_Flux, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_LPC_Flux = sd(LipidC_Flux, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_POC_Flux = mean(POC_Flux, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_POC_Flux = sd(POC_Flux, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_diff = mean(diff_flux, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_diff = sd(diff_flux, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_LPC_POC = mean(LPC_POC, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_LPC_POC = sd(LPC_POC, na.rm = TRUE),
            
            # Cohen's d for paired samples
            cohens_d = mean_diff / sd_diff,
            
            # Shapiro-Wilk normality test on paired differences
            shapiro_obj = list(shapiro.test(diff_flux)),
            shapiro_W = shapiro_obj[[1]]$statistic,
            shapiro_p = shapiro_obj[[1]]$p.value,
            
            
            # paired t-test
            ttest_obj = list(t.test(POC_Flux,
                                    LipidC_Flux,
                                    paired = TRUE,
                                    alternative = "two.sided")),
            
            t_stat = ttest_obj[[1]]$statistic,
            df = ttest_obj[[1]]$parameter,
            p_value = ttest_obj[[1]]$p.value,
            conf_low = ttest_obj[[1]]$conf.int[1],
            conf_high = ttest_obj[[1]]$conf.int[2],
            
            # non parametric wilcox test
            wilcox_obj = list(wilcox.test(POC_Flux, LipidC_Flux, 
                                          paired = TRUE)),
            median_diff = median(LipidC_Flux - POC_Flux, na.rm = TRUE),
            V_wilcox = wilcox_obj[[1]]$statistic,
            p_value_wilcox = wilcox_obj[[1]]$p.value,
            
            
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  select(-shapiro_obj, -ttest_obj, -wilcox_obj) %>% 
  mutate(p_adj_ttest = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
         p_adj_wilcox = p.adjust(p_value_wilcox, method = "BH"),
         is_sig_ttest = p_adj_ttest < 0.05,
         normality_ok = shapiro_p > 0.05, # interpret normality
         is_sig_wilcox = p_adj_wilcox < 0.05) 


Table.S10 <- results.200 %>%
  transmute(
    Region = reg.inuk,
    n = n_pairs,

    Mean_LPC = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f",mean_LPC_Flux, sd_LPC_Flux),
    Mean_POC = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f",mean_POC_Flux, sd_POC_Flux),
    Mean_Diff = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f",mean_diff, sd_diff),
    Mean_LPC_POC = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f",mean_LPC_POC, sd_LPC_POC),

    t = round(t_stat, 2),
    df = round(df, 1),

    p_adj_ttest = signif(p_adj_ttest, 2),
    is_sig_ttest = is_sig_ttest,

    Cohens_d = round(cohens_d, 2),

    Shapiro_p = signif(shapiro_p, 2),
    
    Normality_OK = normality_ok,
    
    V_wilcox = round(V_wilcox, 2),
    p_adj_wilcox = signif(p_adj_wilcox, 2),
    median_diff = round(median_diff, 2),
    is_sig_wilcox = is_sig_wilcox
  ) 

# write.csv(Table.S10, file = "tables/TableS10_POC_vs_LPC_flux.csv")
```

# List of sensitivity analysis supplementary tables and figures in the separate senstivity analysis file (10-calculate_lipidflux_sensitivity_scenarios.Rmd).
- Table S3. is in file 9-hydrobios_lipid_pump.Rmd
- Table S5. Sensitivity analysis on the level of taxonomic curation of the image dataset per subregion. 
- Table S6. Sensitivity analysis on the respiration rate model parameters per subregion.
- Table S7. Sensitivity analysis on the temperature value used in calculating the respiration rate per subregion. 
- Fig. S4. Sensitivity analysis on the natural mortality rate (β) during diapause. 
- Fig. S5. Sensitivity analysis on the fraction of the Calanus spp. population that will not undergo diapause and remain at the epipelagic (0 – 200 m) during winter.
